info: Hand-picked builds. Names must match the wiki exactly; run `npm run check-builds` after a patch to find renamed or removed perks/add-ons. Selected from general community knowledge, not from live statistics.

builds.name: Loop Machine
builds.why: Windows of Opportunity shows every pallet and window, so you always know where the next loop is. Lithe turns a fast vault into a burst of speed that ends many chases early. Decisive Strike and Off the Record together make you very hard to tunnel after an unhook.
builds.howToPlay: Take chases on purpose and run them long. Save Lithe for a strong window so the killer cannot simply follow you. After an unhook, play near your team and use Decisive Strike only when the killer commits to you.

builds.name: Gen Machine
builds.why: Déjà Vu shows the three generators that sit closest together, so you can work on the ones the killer would want to protect. Prove Thyself speeds up gens when you work together, and Hyperfocus rewards a string of great skill checks. Resilience adds repair speed while you are injured, which happens a lot.
builds.howToPlay: Pick a Déjà Vu generator and stay on it. Work together with a teammate to trigger Prove Thyself. Use Brand New Part on a gen that is nearly done when the killer is busy in a chase.

builds.name: Team Anchor
builds.why: Kindred shows everyone (and the killer near the hook) when someone is hooked, so the right person goes for the save. Borrowed Time protects the person you unhook. Reassurance buys time on a hook when you cannot reach it yet, and Deliverance lets you unhook yourself after you made a safe save.
builds.howToPlay: You are the one who does the saves. Make your first unhook early to unlock Deliverance. Use Reassurance when the killer is camping, so you do not have to walk into a trade.

builds.name: Second Life
builds.why: This build is all about not dying first. After you are unhooked, Off the Record hides you and gives Endurance, Decisive Strike punishes a tunnelling killer, and Dead Hard gives one more hit. Unbreakable lets you pick yourself up if the killer slugs you instead.
builds.howToPlay: Good for solo queue against killers who tunnel. Play the early game normally and keep your Dead Hard for when you are about to be hit at a loop.

builds.name: Information Broker
builds.why: Four kinds of information: loops (Windows), teammates (Bond), hooks and the killer near them (Kindred) and the best generators (Déjà Vu). You always know where to go, which helps a lot in solo queue.
builds.howToPlay: Use Bond to find teammates to work on gens with. Use the map to track gens and exits. Ideal when you play without voice chat.

builds.name: Ghost Protocol
builds.why: Distortion blocks the killer's aura-reading perks, so they cannot find you that way. Lightweight makes your scratch marks harder to follow, Quick & Quiet hides fast vaults and locker use, and Urban Evasion lets you move quickly while crouched.
builds.howToPlay: Avoid chases, work on far-away gens and break line of sight early. Strong against aura-reading killers.

builds.name: Endgame Closer
builds.why: Adrenaline heals you and gives a burst of speed as soon as the last gen pops. Hope adds more speed once the gates are powered. Wake Up! shows the exit gates and opens them faster, and Resilience speeds up both gens and gate opening while you are injured.
builds.howToPlay: Play safe early, then go all-in in the endgame. Head straight to a gate when the last gen pops and open it for the team.

builds.name: Boon Builder
builds.why: Turn a dull totem into a safe base: heal fast, recover from the dying state and hide your scratch marks. If the killer snuffs one boon, light it again somewhere else.
builds.howToPlay: Bless a totem in the middle of the map near gens. Lead your team there to heal. Fun to annoy killers who like to slug.

builds.name: Locker Gremlin
builds.why: Quick & Quiet hides your locker hops, Deception fakes where you went, and Head On stuns the killer from a locker. Flashbang lets you make a bright grenade after working on gens. You have stuns, blinds and lies everywhere.
builds.howToPlay: Lure the killer to a locker, slip inside unseen and stun them as they pass. Use the flashlight for save plays. It does not always work, but when it does it is great fun.

builds.name: Hook Saboteur
builds.why: Saboteur shows the hooks near a carried survivor and lets you break them. Breakout speeds up their wiggle. Boil Over and Flip-Flop make you a nightmare to carry yourself.
builds.howToPlay: Follow the chase from a distance and break the nearest hook just before the killer arrives. Best with a friend who plays with you.

builds.name: Chest Goblin
builds.why: Plunderer's Instinct shows chests, Appraisal lets you open them faster and more often, and Ace in the Hole can give you strong add-ons. Streetwise makes your items last longer. Every trial is a treasure hunt, with a key to escape through the hatch.
builds.howToPlay: Visit every chest, swap items when you find a better one and use the key to escape through the hatch.

builds.name: Bleeding Hero
builds.why: No Mither keeps you injured all game but lets you pick yourself up. Resilience gives you its speed bonus all game long because you are always injured. Unbreakable gives you an extra self-pickup, and Iron Will hides your grunts of pain.
builds.howToPlay: Rush gens with the Resilience bonus and keep coming back up. The killer will slug you, so they waste time.

builds.name: Bodyguard
builds.why: You take hits for your team. Borrowed Time and Babysitter protect the person you unhook. Mettle of Man and Dead Hard let you take an extra hit yourself, and Styptic Agent gives you even more.
builds.howToPlay: Stay close to injured or unhooked teammates and step between them and the killer.

builds.name: Last One Standing
builds.why: This is a solo stealth plan for when things go wrong. Sole Survivor blocks the killer's aura reading when you are the last one alive, Left Behind shows the hatch, and the key opens it. Lightweight and Urban Evasion help you stay unseen.
builds.howToPlay: Do gens quietly. When teammates go down, think about whether you can still win the game, or whether you should hide and go for the hatch.

builds.name: Blink Hunter
builds.why: Nurse can teleport anywhere, so the only thing that slows her down is finding survivors. Lethal Pursuer and Nowhere to Hide show where they are. Pain Resonance and Grim Embrace slow the gens without needing extra walking.
builds.howToPlay: Use the start-of-match auras to blink straight to a survivor. Kick gens when Nowhere to Hide can show you who is nearby.

builds.name: Rush Blight
builds.why: Blight moves fast with his power, so he does not need speed perks, only gen pressure. Pain Resonance and Grim Embrace slow gens when you hook. Pop Goes the Weasel adds more after the hook.
builds.howToPlay: Rush to the survivors you saw with Lethal Pursuer, end chases fast with a rush and kick a gen after the hook for Pop.

builds.name: Silent Bell
builds.why: Wraith is already invisible. Tinkerer and Trail of Torment make you undetectable when gens get close to being finished. Dark Devotion moves your terror radius to someone else, so survivors look the wrong way.
builds.howToPlay: Uncloak right next to survivors who are working on a gen. Use Tinkerer to find the gen.

builds.name: Trap Garden
builds.why: Trapper needs time to set up. Corrupt Intervention and Deadlock buy that time early on. With extra traps from the add-ons you can lock down a group of three gens. Brutal Strength helps in loops without traps.
builds.howToPlay: Place traps at the loops near three gens that sit close together, and defend those gens.

builds.name: Swamp Witch
builds.why: Hag teleports to her traps, so she can defend a group of gens. Pain Resonance, Grim Embrace and Dead Man's Switch give strong gen slowdown without extra walking.
builds.howToPlay: Place traps near gens and hooks. Teleport to anyone who walks into a trap.

builds.name: Evil Within IV
builds.why: Tombstone Piece makes you Undetectable as soon as Evil Within III starts, and Judith's Tombstone refreshes Evil Within III every time you hook someone. Monitor & Abuse and Dark Devotion keep you hidden while you stalk, so you can stay in your strongest state for a long time.
builds.howToPlay: Stalk quietly until Evil Within III, then go from survivor to survivor: every hook keeps your power going. Save the Best for Last helps you down the others faster.

builds.name: Corrupted Fountain
builds.why: Plague makes survivors sick, and sick survivors need fountains. Thanatophobia punishes injured survivors with slower gens, and Sloppy Butcher makes healing slower. Survivors have to choose between Corrupt Purge and slow gens.
builds.howToPlay: Infect everyone early and save Corrupt Purge to finish off runs. Stand near fountains when people cleanse.

builds.name: Paparazzi
builds.why: Ghost Face uses stealth to mark survivors. Tinkerer and Monitor & Abuse help you get close unseen. Make Your Choice punishes a survivor who unhooks while you are nearby.
builds.howToPlay: Lean around corners to stalk survivors, mark them and down them with one hit.

builds.name: Box Puzzle
builds.why: Reverse bear traps force survivors to search for boxes instead of working on gens. A hex stack adds even more slowdown. Thrill of the Hunt protects the hexes, so survivors lose time either way.
builds.howToPlay: Put a trap on every survivor who is not wearing one. Defend the hex totems that are close to gens.

builds.name: Blood Fury
builds.why: Oni builds up his power from blood orbs, which drop when survivors are injured. Sloppy Butcher makes survivors bleed more. Pain Resonance and Grim Embrace slow gens while you charge your power.
builds.howToPlay: Hit everyone once to fill your power. Use Blood Fury to down multiple survivors in a row.

builds.name: Mixtape Mayhem
builds.why: Legion's power injures many survivors fast. Thanatophobia and Sloppy Butcher make that extra painful: gens are slower and healing takes longer. Discordance shows where survivors work on gens together.
builds.howToPlay: Use Feral Frenzy on groups of survivors, then go back to downing them with basic attacks.

builds.name: One Shot Huntress
builds.why: With Iridescent Head, each hatchet downs a survivor in one hit. Lethal Pursuer helps you find targets at the start of the match. Huntress Lullaby makes skill checks harder, and Undying keeps your hex alive.
builds.howToPlay: Hit survivors from range. Each throw counts, so aim carefully.

builds.name: Tunnel Crawler
builds.why: Xenomorph travels fast through tunnels. Aura perks show where to go next, and the scourge and Grim Embrace slow gens without extra walking.
builds.howToPlay: Use the tunnels to come out near survivors you saw with your aura perks. Go for long chases only with your tail power.

builds.name: Chainsaw Highway
builds.why: Hillbilly crosses the map fast with his chainsaw. You only need perks to slow the gens and to find survivors at the start.
builds.howToPlay: Sprint to the survivors you saw with Lethal Pursuer. Use the chainsaw to end chases fast.

builds.name: Electro Therapy
builds.why: This build is all about skill checks. Doctor's madness makes skill checks harder, Distressing makes your terror radius bigger, and Unnerving Presence, Huntress Lullaby and Overcharge make survivors fail more checks. Every failed check costs gen time.
builds.howToPlay: Shock survivors on gens and keep your terror radius over as many gens as you can. Then watch the gens explode.

builds.name: No One Leaves
builds.why: This build only kicks in at the end of the match. No Way Out and Remember Me make opening the gates take longer. Blood Warden blocks the gates for everyone, and NOED makes survivors Exposed.
builds.howToPlay: Works on any killer. Play normally, then turn things around in the endgame.

builds.name: Gen Lockdown
builds.why: Four perks that slow the gens and trigger when you hook someone, so you do not need to stop and kick gens. Works on almost any killer.
builds.howToPlay: Spread your hooks over different survivors to get the most out of Grim Embrace. Kick a gen within the Pop time limit.

builds.name: Seeing Red
builds.why: Aura reading at every stage: at the start (Lethal Pursuer), when you kick gens (Nowhere to Hide), after hooks (Barbecue & Chilli) and through the Obsession (Friends 'til the End). Good for killers who move fast.
builds.howToPlay: Use the information after every hook to choose your next target, not the closest one.

builds.name: Solo Queue Savior
builds.why: Kindred gives the information voice chat would give; Windows makes every chase easier; Deliverance and Resilience keep you useful after a hook.
builds.howToPlay: Watch Kindred to decide who goes for the save, and stay on gens otherwise.

builds.name: Skill Check Wizard
builds.why: Stake Out turns good checks into great ones, which feed Hyperfocus stacks for ever faster repairs.
builds.howToPlay: Repair near the killer's terror radius to build Stake Out tokens, then hit every great check.

builds.name: Field Medic
builds.why: Very fast heals for your team and yourself: We'll Make It and Botany Knowledge stack, and Second Wind heals you after your next unhook.
builds.howToPlay: Heal teammates right after unhooks while We'll Make It is active.

builds.name: Vault Master
builds.why: Finesse speeds up fast vaults, Lithe gives speed after one, and Windows shows where to vault next.
builds.howToPlay: Stay healthy for Finesse and chain window loops.

builds.name: Sprint & Survive
builds.why: Spine Chill warns you early, Sprint Burst gets you to safety, and Unbreakable saves you from slugs.
builds.howToPlay: Walk when the killer is near so Sprint Burst stays ready.

builds.name: Urban Legend
builds.why: A quiet build: no grunts, no crows, fast crouching and an early warning.
builds.howToPlay: Crouch away when Spine Chill lights up.

builds.name: Gen Booby Trap
builds.why: Trap gens that the killer kicks: Blast Mine blinds, Wiretap shows the killer, Repressed Alliance blocks a gen they want.
builds.howToPlay: Set traps on the gens the killer patrols.

builds.name: Chemist
builds.why: Turn pallets and windows into traps that slow the killer down.
builds.howToPlay: Do gens to unlock the traps, then lead chases through them.

builds.name: Flashlight Saver
builds.why: All-in on blinding the killer: save teammates from pick-ups and slow down chases.
builds.howToPlay: Follow the killer at a distance and blind them at pick-ups.

builds.name: Never Stay Down
builds.why: Counter slugging killers: you crawl fast, pick yourself up and get Endurance afterwards.
builds.howToPlay: Crawl to the boon or a safe corner and get up.

builds.name: Totem Hunter
builds.why: Find and cleanse every totem fast: no hexes, and Inner Strength heals you in lockers.
builds.howToPlay: Cleanse totems early in the match.

builds.name: Team Gen Squad
builds.why: Bond finds teammates, and Prove Thyself, Leader and Friendly Competition all reward working on gens together.
builds.howToPlay: Repair in pairs.

builds.name: Info Overload
builds.why: You always know where the killer is: Alert, Spine Chill and Kindred together.
builds.howToPlay: Use the info to stay one step ahead.

builds.name: Stun Lord
builds.why: Every stun is rewarded: longer pallet stuns, speed after stuns and hidden escapes.
builds.howToPlay: Play pallets aggressively.

builds.name: Fog Reader
builds.why: Great skill checks show you the killer and speed up repairs.
builds.howToPlay: Hit great checks and watch the killer's aura.

builds.name: Phase Walker
builds.why: Strong all-round slowdown: Grim Embrace and Pain Resonance trigger on hooks, so you keep chasing instead of kicking gens.
builds.howToPlay: Phase to the survivors you see at the start and hook different survivors.

builds.name: Pinball Wizard
builds.why: An anti-loop build: windows get blocked and pallets break faster.
builds.howToPlay: Rush between loops and break everything.

builds.name: Hatchet Pressure
builds.why: Strong all-round slowdown: Grim Embrace and Pain Resonance trigger on hooks, so you keep chasing instead of kicking gens.
builds.howToPlay: Throw at range and save time with hook slowdown.

builds.name: Batting Bell
builds.why: Fast cloaked travel, and Bamboozle stops loops while Pop and Grim hold the gens.
builds.howToPlay: Cloak between chases and uncloak right next to survivors.

builds.name: Hook Highway
builds.why: Traps all over the map and fast carries to any hook.
builds.howToPlay: Set traps everywhere and carry fast.

builds.name: Frenzy Pressure
builds.why: Injure everyone with Feral Frenzy; Thanatophobia and Sloppy Butcher make that very costly.
builds.howToPlay: Frenzy groups, then hook and kick gens.

builds.name: Bottle Service
builds.why: Clown wins loops with his bottles; Bamboozle blocks windows.
builds.howToPlay: Throw bottles at loops and close the distance.

builds.name: Upside Down
builds.why: Portals give map pressure; Surge and Pain Resonance hit gens on downs and hooks.
builds.howToPlay: Place portals near gens.

builds.name: Reel Them In
builds.why: Strong all-round slowdown: Grim Embrace and Pain Resonance trigger on hooks, so you keep chasing instead of kicking gens.
builds.howToPlay: Shoot at mid range and spread your hooks.

builds.name: Pyramid Head
builds.why: Strong all-round slowdown: Grim Embrace and Pain Resonance trigger on hooks, so you keep chasing instead of kicking gens.
builds.howToPlay: Use Rites of Judgement through walls.

builds.name: Knife Show
builds.why: Strong all-round slowdown: Grim Embrace and Pain Resonance trigger on hooks, so you keep chasing instead of kicking gens.
builds.howToPlay: Throw at long range in open areas.

builds.name: Tyrant
builds.why: Strong all-round slowdown: Grim Embrace and Pain Resonance trigger on hooks, so you keep chasing instead of kicking gens.
builds.howToPlay: Infect with the tentacle and let the zombies help.

builds.name: Chains of Pain
builds.why: The Cenobite's own perks together: Plaything reveals survivors, Gift of Pain and Deadlock slow the gens.
builds.howToPlay: Hook on scourge hooks and keep the box away from survivors.

builds.name: Crow Commander
builds.why: Strong all-round slowdown: Grim Embrace and Pain Resonance trigger on hooks, so you keep chasing instead of kicking gens.
builds.howToPlay: Send crows over gens and loops.

builds.name: TV Hopper
builds.why: Teleport through TVs and stack scourge hook effects.
builds.howToPlay: Hook on scourge hooks and teleport to gens.

builds.name: Nightfall
builds.why: Strong all-round slowdown: Grim Embrace and Pain Resonance trigger on hooks, so you keep chasing instead of kicking gens.
builds.howToPlay: Use lockers to cross the map.

builds.name: Guard Duty
builds.why: Strong all-round slowdown: Grim Embrace and Pain Resonance trigger on hooks, so you keep chasing instead of kicking gens.
builds.howToPlay: Send guards to break loops.

builds.name: Biopod Net
builds.why: Strong all-round slowdown: Grim Embrace and Pain Resonance trigger on hooks, so you keep chasing instead of kicking gens.
builds.howToPlay: Place biopods near gens and teleport.

builds.name: Hidey-Ho
builds.why: Strong all-round slowdown: Grim Embrace and Pain Resonance trigger on hooks, so you keep chasing instead of kicking gens.
builds.howToPlay: Dash in and out of chases.

builds.name: Cryptid
builds.why: Strong all-round slowdown: Grim Embrace and Pain Resonance trigger on hooks, so you keep chasing instead of kicking gens.
builds.howToPlay: Hit with your power around corners.

builds.name: Pack Hunter
builds.why: Strong all-round slowdown: Grim Embrace and Pain Resonance trigger on hooks, so you keep chasing instead of kicking gens.
builds.howToPlay: Send the dog to find and catch survivors.

builds.name: Hex Gambler
builds.why: A high-risk hex stack: Undying protects, Haunted Ground and Retribution punish cleansing, Devour Hope snowballs.
builds.howToPlay: Keep hooking away from your hexes.

builds.name: No Healing Allowed
builds.why: Healing becomes slow and dangerous; injured survivors slow the gens.
builds.howToPlay: Hit everyone once and catch them while they heal.

builds.name: Exposed Express
builds.why: Many ways to make survivors Exposed for one-hit downs.
builds.howToPlay: Chase right after unhooks and stuns.

builds.name: First Trials
builds.why: Kindred and Bond show where your team is, Spine Chill warns you when the killer looks your way, and Sprint Burst gives you a head start when a chase begins. Only uses perks every survivor has from the start (General perks) plus one or two perks from the free base-game characters, so you can run it right away.
builds.howToPlay: Walk instead of running so Sprint Burst stays ready. When Spine Chill lights up, stop and look around. Use the auras to find teammates who need help.

builds.name: Safe & Sound
builds.why: Botany Knowledge and We'll Make It make healing much faster, Resilience speeds you up while injured, and Prove Thyself rewards working on generators together. Only uses perks every survivor has from the start (General perks) plus one or two perks from the free base-game characters, so you can run it right away.
builds.howToPlay: Stay near your team, heal anyone who is injured and work on gens in pairs. Unhook teammates and heal them right after.

builds.name: Quiet Rookie
builds.why: Iron Will makes you silent while injured, Urban Evasion lets you crouch-walk at speed and Lightweight hides your footprints, so the killer has a hard time finding you. Only uses perks every survivor has from the start (General perks) plus one or two perks from the free base-game characters, so you can run it right away.
builds.howToPlay: Crouch behind walls and grass when the killer comes close. Bring the Toolbox to finish gens faster while staying hidden.

builds.name: Never Give Up
builds.why: Déjà Vu points you to the generators to finish, Adrenaline heals you and gives a speed burst when the last gen is done, and Hope makes you even faster in the endgame. Only uses perks every survivor has from the start (General perks) plus one or two perks from the free base-game characters, so you can run it right away.
builds.howToPlay: Keep doing generators. When the last one pops, Adrenaline and Hope give you the speed to reach the exit gate.

builds.name: Chest Explorer
builds.why: Plunderer's Instinct shows chests so you can find better items, Self-Care lets you heal alone, and Leader speeds up your teammates nearby. Only uses perks every survivor has from the start (General perks) plus one or two perks from the free base-game characters, so you can run it right away.
builds.howToPlay: Open the chests you see early in the match. Heal yourself with Self-Care when nobody is near, then join a teammate on a gen.

builds.name: Unhook Hero
builds.why: Kindred shows who is near a hooked survivor, Bond and Empathy show where teammates are and who is hurt, and We'll Make It lets you heal them quickly after the save. Only uses perks every survivor has from the start (General perks) plus one or two perks from the free base-game characters, so you can run it right away.
builds.howToPlay: Be the one who goes for the unhook. Wait until the killer walks away from the hook, save, then heal the survivor right away.

builds.name: Hook Learner
builds.why: Bitter Murmur shows survivors when a gen finishes, Bloodhound makes blood trails easy to follow, Sloppy Butcher slows their healing and Brutal Strength breaks pallets faster. Only uses General perks every killer has, plus one or two perks from the free base-game killers, so you can run it right away.
builds.howToPlay: Follow the blood and scratch marks. When a gen is done, go to the auras Bitter Murmur shows you.

builds.name: Gen Defender
builds.why: Thanatophobia slows repairs for every injured survivor, Sloppy Butcher keeps them injured longer, Whispers tells you when someone is near and Agitation speeds up carrying. Only uses General perks every killer has, plus one or two perks from the free base-game killers, so you can run it right away.
builds.howToPlay: Hit as many survivors as you can. Injured survivors work slower, so keep pressure on everyone instead of one person.

builds.name: Hex Hunter
builds.why: Thrill of the Hunt protects your hex totems, No One Escapes Death makes the endgame deadly, Enduring helps against pallets and Unnerving Presence makes skill checks harder. Only uses General perks every killer has, plus one or two perks from the free base-game killers, so you can run it right away.
builds.howToPlay: Do not give up if gens are done: when the gates are powered, No One Escapes Death makes your hits one-shot downs.

builds.name: Trapper Starter
builds.why: Agitation makes carrying survivors to your traps and hooks faster, Enduring helps you chase through pallets, Bitter Murmur and Deerstalker give easy information. Only uses General perks every killer has, plus one or two perks from the free base-game killers, so you can run it right away.
builds.howToPlay: Set traps near gens, pallets and windows. Survivors caught in traps are easy downs.

builds.name: Sneaky Wraith
builds.why: Whispers and Spies from the Shadows tell you where survivors are while you are invisible, Bloodhound helps you follow injured ones and Unrelenting gets you back into chase fast after a miss. Only uses General perks every killer has, plus one or two perks from the free base-game killers, so you can run it right away.
builds.howToPlay: Stay cloaked while you travel and uncloak right next to a survivor for a surprise hit.

builds.name: No Healing Allowed
builds.why: Sloppy Butcher and Thanatophobia punish survivors for being injured, Distressing makes your terror radius bigger so they stay scared, and Enduring helps in chases. Only uses General perks every killer has, plus one or two perks from the free base-game killers, so you can run it right away.
builds.howToPlay: Spread your hits over different survivors so many stay injured and slow.
